description: Angular component for customizing button toggle styles in a widget, including popover interactions and appearance updates.

classes.name: WidgetButtonToggleCustomStyleComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing custom styles of a toggle button in a widget, with popover UI for style editing.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component and updates appearance preview.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input changes, updates appearance when 'appearance' input changes.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the current style model and updates appearance preview.

methods.name: openButtonCustomStylePopup
methods.description: Opens a popover for editing custom button styles.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the style model and propagates change.

methods.name: updatePreviewAppearance
methods.description: Updates the appearance preview based on current style model.
